name: Secure Crate
summary: In the Barrens, a Secure Crate waits for a traveler to carry it to Ratchet. Potions and alchemical goods inside are bound for the Eastern Kingdoms.

sections.title: A Courier's Cargo
sections.body: Couriers, caravans, and goblin ships carry trade between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms. When a Barrens caravan misses its departure, travelers take fragile cargo like this Secure Crate down to the coast. It holds potions, alchemical goods, and reagents for associates across the Great Sea. The crate is sealed against the Barrens trails and the sea spray on its voyage.

sections.title: Through the Port of Ratchet
sections.body: The crate’s land journey ends at the Ratchet docks, where Wharfmaster Dizzywig oversees shipping. Ratchet is a neutral port for goods crossing the sea, including cargo bound for Blackwater Cove. Dizzywig works under the Steamwheedle Cartel’s ledger, recording parcels and freight before loading them onto the next departing vessel. Ratchet links the Old World with the frontier.

faq.q: What is inside the Secure Crate?
faq.answer: The Secure Crate holds potions, alchemical reagents, and other supplies for associates in the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Where is the crate being sent?
faq.answer: Carry it to Wharfmaster Dizzywig on the Ratchet docks. He will book it onto a merchant vessel bound for Blackwater Cove in the Old World.

faq.q: Why was the crate given to an adventurer instead of a caravan?
aliases: why do i have the crate
faq.answer: The sender could not make the journey to Ratchet in time, and the scheduled trade caravan had already left. A hired courier must get the crate to the docks in time for the tide.

faq.q: Who takes the crate at Ratchet?
faq.answer: Wharfmaster Dizzywig receives the crate on the Ratchet docks and records it in his shipping ledger before loading it onto the next ship sailing with the tide.

angles.text: As an herbalist, you can see how cross-sea alchemists and herbalists rely on frontier trade routes to exchange raw ingredients.
As a Horde traveler, you know Ratchet’s neutral port links Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms through goblin shipping.
